craft_notes: Sthāyin: three natures. Rows: light, swing, dark. Read aloud: three lamps.

lines: Where happiness meets the light of fruition,
that is lucidity; where sorrow swings
through light and unlight, there is motion;
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatra sukhaṃ bhogyarūpaprakāśaḥ sattvam duḥkhaṃ prakāśāprakāśāndolanātmakam ata eva kriyārūpaṃ rajaḥ mohaḥ prakāśābhāvarūpas tamaḥ
